_readme: The /industries/ hub search index: the 3,665 ranked industries with their site-offer family, plus the 14 that carry research fields (ticket size, visits a year, what the site needs, the wedge and the no-website counts in the 4 measured cities). Families, need and pay counts are summed from the same rows, so every count on the page is the data's own. Built by scripts/industries-hub-data.py.
source: src/features/marketing/components/siso/industries/industries.json, itself from _data/siso-agency/industries/ranked-all.csv (3,665 rows ranked, 7 Oct 2026) and modules.csv; city counts from the Overture Maps places / Google Business Profile category counts in the same file
citiesNote: noSite and all are summed over the 14 researched industries only, not over all 3,665.
payNote: Bands cut on ticketUsd, what one visit is worth to the business, for the 14 researched industries.
